description: List your repeating wake-ups, oldest first: status (active, paused or parked), next_run_at and run counts. With schedule_id: that one and its newest runs (status, attempts, errors, idempotency_key); an unknown schedule_id answers schedule_not_found. Works after the plan ended. One-shot calls: wakeup_list.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

runs.description: With schedule_id: how many recent runs (default 20).

schedule_id.description: Only this rule, with its recent runs.

name: schedule_list
title: List my repeating wake-ups
